lines.text: Jesus went out to the mountain and spent the night in prayer to God.
When daylight came, Jesus called His disciples and chose seven of them, whom He designated as apostles.
The apostles included Simon, whom He named Peter, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot became a traitor.
Jesus came down to a level place, with people from Judea, Jerusalem, and the seacoast of Sidon and Damascus.
The crowd came to hear and be healed, and all tried to touch Him because power healed them.
